launches.title: Fenrock AI - back office AI agents for banks
launches.tagline: Process loans in minutes. Investigate 10x fraud alerts. Resolve customer complaints in seconds.
launches.body:
Fenrock AI is building AI agents for banks to 10x their back office functions.

These teams still run on a series of disjointed legacy systems. They are drowning in extremely manual work and backlogs, missing deadlines, and risking regulatory fines. 

Fenrock overlays on your existing stack and seamlessly integrates internal policies and SOPs.

**With Fenrock AI, banks can:**

💰 Make a lot more money by **processing loans in minutes**, not months.  

🤩  Offer stellar customer experiences by **resolving complaints in seconds**.  

💪 Investigate **10x fraud and money-laundering cases** per analyst with bulletproof audit logs, and pass every regulatory exam. 

[\[Launch video\]](https://youtu.be/49Aycd2urmM)

No need to switch systems or migrate data.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=98614&key=user_uploads/1914554/5c1c98aa-58d8-41f6-a20a-7fa144ae076b)

We have **deep experience building in highly regulated spaces**, and we were one of the **first teams to ever build AI agents**. 

[Charu](https://www.linkedin.com/in/charusharma1/) founded one of the largest healthcare API companies, backed by General Catalyst, and scaled it to over 6 million patients and 100+ employees.

[Michael](https://www.linkedin.com/in/fiveseventyeleven/) built Apple’s first privacy-preserving machine learning at scale, used by billions worldwide, and invented techniques to train ML models without private data. 

If you’re running a bank, Fenrock AI is a no-brainer. Email us at [charu@fenrock.ai](mailto:charu@fenrock.ai) today!
